content.title: About
content.content: Black Forest ham is a smoked pork ham sliced into thin pieces. It has a delicate smoky aroma, a slightly sweet flavor with subtle spice notes, and a characteristic pink color. The product is ready to eat and is commonly used in sandwiches, salads, and appetizers.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The name “Black Forest” comes from the Schwarzwald region in Germany, known for traditional smoked meat products.
The ham is smoked over wood chips, usually alder or beech, which gives it its distinctive flavor.
Thin slicing allows quick addition to dishes without further preparation.
It is often featured in classic German dishes such as pretzel with ham and cheese.
Vacuum packaging and smoking give the product a long shelf life.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Ham provides high‑quality animal protein essential for tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Source of vitamin B12
items.content: Vitamin B12 supports red blood cell formation and nervous system health.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: The iron in ham is highly bioavailable and helps maintain normal hemoglobin levels.

items.title: Provides zinc
items.content: Zinc contributes to immune function and wound healing.

items.title: Low in carbohydrates
items.content: Ham fits well into low‑carb dietary patterns.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Ham contains a notable amount of salt, which may be a concern for people with hypertension.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Some varieties contain nitrites and other preservatives that should be consumed in moderation.

items.title: Meat allergy
items.content: A minority of individuals may experience allergic reactions to pork.

items.title: Saturated fat
items.content: Ham includes saturated fats, so intake should be balanced within a heart‑healthy diet.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Ham can be eaten straight from the package, added to sandwiches, salads, wraps, or used in hot dishes such as omelets and casseroles. Thin slices are ideal for topping hot dishes at the end of cooking to warm them slightly.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the ham in its original vacuum‑sealed package in the refrigerator at 0 °C–4 °C. After opening, transfer to an airtight container and consume within 5–7 days. When frozen, quality is maintained for up to 2 months.
